# Principles

## Principles
1. The canonical contracts in specs/openapi/ and specs/asyncapi/ are the source of truth for every API — ADR-0003.
2. A module never reads another module's tables — ADR-0001.

## Starting work
- Read `specs/adr/adr-index.md` first and load the ADRs its matching blocks list.
- Open an existing file in the area before writing one, so its rules load.
